run_variety.reason: Build and decision diversity are not measured by starting weapons, outcome entropy, or duration variance.

performance_outlier_frequency.reason: 0/451 official victories crossed robust z >= 3.5 on at least two non-zero-MAD features. Relative performance outliers do not establish exploits or satisfying power growth.

item_viability.reason: Item interaction data is absent or malformed in at least one run (legacy/mixed input).
